newsitem.title: USA: Staples Inc hearing set for May 19.
newsitem.headline: Staples Inc hearing set for May 19.

text.p: A federal District Court judge on Monday set a five-day hearing for May 19 on the government's move to block a merger between Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc .
Judge Thomas Hogan said each side would have two-and-one-half days to present witnesses and arguments.
Staples had sought a 10-day hearing with nearly two dozen witnesses, while the Federal Trade Commission had urged the judge to make his decision based solely on comprehensive written filings.
The judge also set June 5 for further oral arguments and said he would rule within the two weeks following the completion of arguments.
Many of the filings in the case are confidential. Dow Jones Inc, a news organization, filed papers with the judge seeking to open many of those filings.

At issue in the hearing is whether the judge should grant the government's request for a preliminary injunction to block the merger, which would last until all legal proceedings on the case were over.
The government plans to hold an administrative law trial on the merits of the case if a preliminary injunction is issued.
But the attorney for Staples and Office Depot said that if the government wins the preliminary injunction, the case is virtually over.
